language_description: Select your interface language. Changes will be applied immediately.
models_description: You can turn on/off the AI models you want to use. At least one model must be active.
google_models_managed_separately: Google models are managed from the Google Session section.
sites_description: Add regular websites here. These sites will not have selector saving, they will only open as web views.
prompts_description: Select a prompt to automatically prepend to your messages or images.
quick_presets_section_desc: Customize button labels and instructions sent to AI when clicking quick preset buttons on the text selection toolbar.
storage_description: View and manage cache storage for AI model partitions.
ai_lifecycle_description: Configure how many AI sites stay active and when they go to sleep.
max_alive_tabs_description: Number of AI tabs kept warm in background (1 = only active tab).
sleep_timeout_description: How long before an inactive tab is put to sleep.
never_sleep_sites_description: Select sites that should never be put to sleep.
bottom_bar_description: Configure which tools and AI models appear in the hub.
tools_visibility_desc: Choose which tools are shown in the hub.
model_visibility_desc: Choose which AI models are shown in the hub.
text_input_mode_description: Choose how text is inserted into website input fields.
text_input_mode_auto_desc: Uses paste when possible and falls back to typing if needed.
text_input_mode_typing_desc: Types text into fields instead of pasting.
typing_speed_description: How fast characters are typed in Human Typing mode.
settings_header_description: Manage your Quizlab Reader workspace, models, prompts and automation settings.
select_setting_from_list: Select a setting from the list to configure
docling_description: Optional Docling engine for intelligent PDF reading. Runs locally and can be installed or removed at any time.
docling_remove_confirm_desc: The Docling engine and models will be removed.
docling_remove_confirm_note: Your documents inside QuizLab will not be deleted.
docling_models_note: You can clear just the models without removing the engine. Models are required for offline conversion.
docling_pipeline_subtitle: Speed vs. quality balance. Changes apply on the next conversion and invalidate the cache.
docling_pipeline_ocr_desc: Off = faster. Retries automatically when no text is found.
docling_pipeline_tables_desc: Preserves table structure. If off, tables become paragraphs.
docling_preset_1_desc: Fastest. Text only, OCR/code/formula/picture analysis and table detection off.
docling_preset_2_desc: Text + fast tables. Images and enrichments off.
docling_preset_3_desc: Text + fast tables + figures + heading hierarchy. Balanced quality/speed for daily use.
docling_preset_4_desc: OCR + figures + code/formula + picture classification + chart + heading hierarchy on.
docling_preset_5_desc: All analyses on: VLM picture description and accurate table mode included, slowest/highest quality.
docling_preset_custom_desc: You edited an advanced option away from the presets. The pipeline runs with your custom settings.
docling_preset_hint: Level 1 is the most basic/fastest scan, 5 the most detailed/slowest. 3 is the default middle.
docling_pipeline_ocr_lang_hint: RapidOCR supports single language; multi-language requires EasyOCR.
docling_pipeline_force_full_ocr_desc: OCR every page — very slow; only for scanned PDFs.
docling_pipeline_pic_desc_desc: Caption via vision model — very slow.
docling_pipeline_cell_match_desc: Matches table cells to PDF cells.
docling_pipeline_remote_desc: Allows cloud OCR/VLM usage — if enabled, document data may be transmitted to configured external services. Off by default; processing stays local otherwise.
docling_pipeline_plugins_desc: ⚠ Allows Docling to run external Python plugins — a security risk. Keep off unless you know what you are doing.
docling_pipeline_timeout_hint: 0 = no Docling-side timeout. QuizLab's overall processing limit (15 min) always applies; the document timeout can be at most 540 s.
docling_pipeline_apply_note: Changes take effect on the next conversion and miss the cache.
